`final class MemoryResourceCache`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceCache`](/reference/resources/iresourcecache/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.cache` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MemoryResourceCache.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/cache/MemoryResourceCache.java)

The default resource cache, which keeps the data in memory while it is used and for a while after.

## Description

Data stays as long as a resource uses it, then for `expiry` after its last access, within `size` entries.
